description.value: Sports Illustrated Clubhouse is a licensed sports bar and restaurant operating under the Sports Illustrated brand near UBC in Vancouver, designed as a communal gameday venue with large screens and a stadium atmosphere. The menu spans wings, sliders, poutine, brunch, and craft cocktails, with daily specials and a dedicated happy hour. The venue also offers online ordering, private event catering, and holds regular themed nights and live DJ events.
